page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5.4xlarge is a member of the Local SSDs instance family, configured to provide direct-attached storage capacity alongside high memory density. The instance runs on the KVM hypervisor and is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor with a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. Compute resources include 16 dedicated vCPUs combined with 128 GB of RAM, establishing an allocation ratio of 8 GB per core.

Integrated local storage is provided via a 3839 GB solid-state drive directly mounted to the host, eliminating network protocol overhead for disk read and write operations. The platform offers a baseline network bandwidth of 40 Gbps to support high-throughput cluster communication. The instance does not include discrete GPU accelerators and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, relying on private networking or secondary routing.

The bundled 3839 GB local SSD and 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio optimize resource density for I/O-sensitive, memory-heavy workloads without requiring external block storage arrays. A key architectural consideration is the ephemeral nature of direct-attached SSD storage, which requires application-level replication or regular backup strategies to mitigate data loss risk. The configuration is appropriate for relational databases, distributed NoSQL datastores, Elasticsearch clusters, and analytical processing engines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5.4xlarge is an x86_64 virtual server instance from the Local SSDs family running on the KVM hypervisor. Driven by a dedicated 16-vCPU Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor clocked at 3.4 GHz, it provides 128 GB of system memory, matching an 8 GB per vCPU allocation ratio. Its primary hardware feature is an integrated 3839 GB local solid-state drive, which delivers direct disk access without the latency constraints of network storage volumes. Network connectivity features a 40 Gbps baseline bandwidth, while the instance omits discrete GPU hardware and complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Combining large local storage, substantial memory, and dedicated compute, this server type is structured for high-performance database management, distributed data stores, index indexing engines, and transactional caching workloads.
